moa: Fumaric acid ester prodrug of monomethyl fumarate; activates the Nrf2 antioxidant response pathway (mechanism in MS not fully established)

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 211855 NDA APPROVAL Alkermes, Inc. ... for Vumerity (diroximel fumarate) delayed-release capsules ... It is approved, effective on the date of this letter (electronic signature page dated 10/29/2019)

search_log: Listed Biogen (CIK 0000875045) filings from data.sec.gov/submissions (recent + older files), keeping every 8-K and 8-K/A with item 2.02, or 9.01 exhibits, 2013-04 onward; the 2022-07-20 8-K/A (0000875045-22-000023) carries the same exhibit as the original 8-K with a one-character year fix in unrelated text, original 8-K used.

Fetched each filing's index.json, took the earnings-release exhibit (EX-99.1; file names q<N><YYYY>pressrelease.htm, ye2013pressrelease.htm, exhibit991-q<N><YYYY>pressrele.htm), parsed every table row, selected the product row.

Row selection rule: first row in the release whose label equals the product name; for releases that carry both a whole-million summary table and a one-decimal U.S./Rest of World/Total table, the one-decimal table row; value is the Total column for the current quarter (first triple).
Biogen's 2020Q3 release footnote: 'VUMERITY became commercially available in the U.S. in November 2019'; 2019Q4 release prints the first VUMERITY row (5.5).

VUMERITY is printed on its own line in every release from 2019Q4 on (not only inside 'Total Fumarate'); for 2020Q1-2020Q3 only the whole-million summary-table row is separate, because the detailed table shows a combined 'Fumarate' line.
The approval letter is addressed to Alkermes as NDA applicant; the revenue series is the one Biogen prints in its own releases.
